details.further_information: Riteriai received 15% of the fee from his Lorient move due to a sell-on clause. The original amount was 0.15M€, which increased to approx. 1,35M€.  Porto have a €8M buy option with €250k in bonuses, with Nice having a 10% profit sell-on clause.
